verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms turbopuffer serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured docs index, and it links to markdown versions of individual doc pages (quickstart.md, vector.md, query.md, write.md, etc.) that an agent can ingest directly. The root /docs.md returns 404, but per-page markdown docs are available. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
